headline: The Improbable, Slightly Surreal Plan to Save Fashion’s Printed Matter
snippet: The new International Library for Fashion Research in Oslo, the brainchild of a fashion odd couple, has very big ambitions.

headline: Sigourney Weaver Goes Her Own Way
snippet: In performances both profound and eccentric — and in films that span several genres — the statuesque actress reveals she is a woman who defies definition and embraces adventure.

headline: Edward Frenkel: The Age of a Child
snippet: Celebrate the 101st birthday of recreational mathematician Martin Gardner with two puzzles from the best-selling author Edward Frenkel.

headline: IBM Sales and Profit Dropped 14% in Third Quarter
snippet: Analysts say IBM is struggling to offset the erosion of some of its traditional hardware, software and services businesses.
